name: Hobgoblin
summary: Roderick Kingsley is the original Hobgoblin, a mercenary who steals Norman Osborn’s equipment and sells fear as a business. Other people have worn the identity. This record does not merge them into one person.
relation: Spider-Man rogue. The original Hobgoblin is Roderick Kingsley.
creators: Roger Stern and John Romita Jr.
powers: Goblin glider, pumpkin bombs, and later strength from the Goblin formula. Kingsley is also a planner who hires others.
origin: A fashion criminal who finds hidden Osborn weapons and builds a profitable double life.
